verdict.rationale: For a processor, a documented public API means a programming interface to its compute units. Qualcomm's developer portal lists the Qualcomm AI Engine Direct SDK for deploying models to the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs, and AI Hub/GenieX offer a runtime across NPU, GPU and CPU. This is only a thin mention with no API reference shown, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: API reference documentation specific to X2 Elite Extreme, evidence of agent-friendly programmatic control, hands-on or independent corroboration of the SDK working on this chip

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
